title: Welcome to Žodis
subtitle: Practical Lithuanian for real life.
points: Use Žodis to translate, listen, save useful phrases, and practise them.
Build a personal Library around the Lithuanian you actually need.
Use Lessons and Scenarios to turn saved language into real practice.

title: Your Profile
subtitle: A little context makes Lithuanian more accurate.
points: Žodis asks for your preferred first name, speaker gender, date of birth, where you are from, and where you live.
This is used only inside Žodis to tailor Lithuanian forms, examples, country phrases, and age-relevant lesson content.
You can edit your profile later from Settings.

title: Translate and Listen
subtitle: Home is your quick translation space.
points: Type what you want to say, or hold the mic to speak.
Play Lithuanian audio at normal speed, and use slow playback where available.
Copy, save, or add useful translations to a Scenario.

title: Save Phrases That Matter
subtitle: Saved phrases become learning material.
points: When you save a phrase, Žodis can turn it into an enriched Library card.
Cards can include notes, usage context, alternative Lithuanian phrases, audio, and review value.
Over time, your Library becomes a practical record of what you are learning.

title: Library
subtitle: Your saved Lithuanian lives here.
points: Search, sort, play audio, and review saved entries.
Tap Lithuanian words to hear individual word audio where available.
Edit entries or add useful phrases to Scenarios.

title: Scenarios
subtitle: Group phrases by real-life situation.
points: Create collections for cafés, travel, small talk, appointments, or anything else you need.
Add phrases from Home or the Library.
Open a Scenario to review, play, reorder, or manage its phrases.

title: Lessons
subtitle: Structured practice for steady progress.
points: Lessons include listening, phrase building, matching, and short scenario-style practice.
They use your profile for personal examples like country phrases and age lines.
Browse the course anytime from Training.

title: Speaking Practice
subtitle: Speak, check, and keep going.
points: In speaking checks, hold to speak and release to check.
Žodis gives simple learner-friendly feedback instead of showing raw transcripts.
Use audio first, then try saying the phrase yourself.

title: Settings and Coming Soon
subtitle: Control your learning setup.
points: Settings lets you edit your profile, voice, phonetics, daily recall, sync, and guide access.
Sync is manual so you choose when to upload, download, or merge your Library.
Exam-style practice is planned for a later Beta 3.x update.
